::: {#exr-rv-7}

::: {#exr-rv-9}
If $X\sim Binomial(3,0.2)$. Calculate $\mathbb{P}r(X=0)$.
:::

::: {.solution  .column-screen-inset-right .callout-tip collapse="true"}
#### Solution:

::: {#6b568bce .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import math 

def binom(n,p,x):
    return round(math.comb(n,x) * p**x * (1-p)**(n-x),2)

print(f'{binom(n=3,p=0.2,x=0)=}')
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
binom(n=3,p=0.2,x=0)=0.51
```
:::
:::


:::
